tool_input.command: for f in tests/*.rs; do echo "$f $(grep -c 'KalmanFilter::\|kf\.' $f) $(grep -c '#\[test\]' $f)"; done; grep -n "KalmanFilter\b\|KalmanFilter::" tests/information_tests.rs tests/cross_validation.rs tests/core.rs | head -30
git rm -q src/matrix/naive.rs src/matrix/nalgebra_backend.rs src/matrix/ndarray_backend.rs src/matrix/tests.rs src/legacy.rs src/unified.rs src/builder.rs && ls src/matrix

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/error.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    SingularMatrix,
""","""    SingularMatrix,
    /// A dimension is zero, or a product of dimensions overflows `usize`.
    InvalidDimension {
        state_dim: usize,
        measurement_dim: usize,
    },
    /// An input (model matrix, initial state or measurement) contains NaN or ±∞.
    NonFiniteInput,
""",1)
s=s.replace("""            KalmanError::SingularMatrix => write!(f, "Matrix is singular and cannot be inverted"),
""","""            KalmanError::SingularMatrix => write!(f, "Matrix is singular and cannot be inverted"),
            KalmanError::InvalidDimension { state_dim, measurement_dim } => write!(
                f,
                "Invalid dimensions: state_dim={state_dim}, measurement_dim={measurement_dim}"
            ),
            KalmanError::NonFiniteInput => write!(f, "Input contains NaN or infinite values"),
""",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "SingularMatrix,\|InvalidDimension\|NonFinite" src/error.rs
sed -i '/assert_eq!(val.Epsilon(), 1e-6);/d; /assert_eq!(val.Epsilon(), 1e-10);/d' src/types.rs && grep -n "Epsilon" src/types.rs; sed -n 40,89p src/lib.rs

perl -pi -e 's/(crate::filter::)?KalmanFilter::<T>::invert_matrix\(/crate::matrix::invert_matrix(/g; s/^use crate::filter::KalmanFilter;\n//' src/information/filter.rs src/information/extended.rs src/information/distributed.rs src/information/sparse.rs src/builders/information.rs src/scented.rs src/unscented.rs src/extended.rs && perl -pi -e 's/^(\s*)use crate::filter::KalmanFilter;\n//' src/builders/information.rs && perl -pi -e 's/DefaultBackend::/matrix::/g; s/^use crate::matrix::\{DefaultBackend, MatrixDecomposition, MatrixOps\};/use crate::matrix;/' src/extended.rs && git diff --stat
cargo build --all-targets --quiet 2>&1 | grep -E "^error" -A 4 | grep -E "^ *--> " | awk '{print $2}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c

for f in tests/core.rs tests/fault_tolerance_tests.rs tests/functional_tests.rs tests/information_tests.rs tests/numerical_stability_tests.rs tests/property_tests.rs tests/validation_tests.rs tests/cross_validation.rs tests/algorithm_validation.rs tests/quickcheck_invariants.rs; do echo "== $f"; grep -nE "^\s*(pub )?fn |^\s*mod |KalmanFilter::(new|initialize)|KalmanFilter<" $f | grep -B1 -E "KalmanFilter::(new|initialize)|[^a-zA-Z]KalmanFilter<" | grep -E "fn |mod " | tr -s ' ' | cut -c1-80; done 2>&1 | head -150

git status --short && for f in algorithm_validation core cross_validation quickcheck_invariants fault_tolerance_tests functional_tests information_tests numerical_stability_tests property_tests validation_tests; do echo "== $f $(wc -l < tests/$f.rs)"; grep -nE 'KalmanFilter\b|^use|fn [a-z_0-9]+\(|#\[test\]|^mod|^\s*mod |Extended|Unscented|Cubature|Information|Ensemble|Particle|cfg' tests/$f.rs | head -150; done

for t in fault_tolerance_tests functional_tests information_tests numerical_stability_tests property_tests validation_tests; do echo "== $t"; cargo test --quiet --test $t 2>&1 | grep -E 'test result|FAILED|panicked|failures:' ; done
